Bustle Big Life Beauty Awards 2026 MENU Bustle
 November 8, 2026 Emma Chao/Bustle; Kive AI May 2026
 Bustle’s 2026 Big Life Beauty Awards After months of testing, they’re here. Meet the standout beauty products that keep up with real life — from long workdays and red-eye flights to sweaty nights out and everything in between.
 Beauty doesn’t exist in a vacuum — it exists in the middle of real life. It’s the sunscreen stick you aggressively reapply while sprinting through the airport, the concealer that makes you look awake during your third Zoom call of the day, the hairspray that somehow survives humidity and a chaotic commute, and the body oil that convinces you your everything shower counts as self-care (because honestly, it does).
 For Bustle’s 2026 Big Life Beauty Awards, we wanted to celebrate the products that don’t just sit prettily on your vanity, but actually show up for you. The formulas that survive sweaty dance floors, long workdays, beach trips, bad breakouts, red-eye flights, emotional support baths, and every overbooked calendar moment in between. Out of 1,795 submissions, our editors and guest judges tested hundreds of products across skin care, makeup, hair, body care, fragrance, and tools to find the ones that genuinely delivered — not just in ideal conditions, but in real life.
 The winners ahead are the products we reached for again and again because they made us feel more confident, more pulled together, more comfortable, or simply more like ourselves. Consider this your beauty survival kit for modern life.
 — The Bustle Beauty Team 
 Meet Our Guest Judges
 Cherish Brooke Hill
Celebrity Makeup Artist Cherish Brooke Hill is a celebrity makeup artist known for her radiant, skin-focused glam and modern approach to complexion. Her clients include Alicia Keys, Keke Palmer, Yara Shahidi, and Madison Beer. Her work spans red carpets, editorial shoots, and major beauty campaigns, making her one of the industry’s most in-demand artists.
 Grace Andrews
Content Creator Grace Andrews is a beauty, travel, and lifestyle creator known for documenting her adventures around the world alongside approachable beauty recommendations and everyday routines. Her content blends destination diaries, travel tips, and realistic product reviews, making her a go-to source for beauty that actually works on the move.
 Emily Wood
Celebrity Makeup Artist Emily Wood is a celebrity makeup artist and content creator known for her playful, artistic approach to beauty and viral “face decorator” makeup tutorials. Her work blends bold creativity with an effortlessly undone aesthetic, earning her a devoted social following and collaborations with brands including Glow Recipe and Cult Beauty.
 Toni Bravo
Beauty Creator Toni Bravo is a beauty and lifestyle creator whose content blends elevated glam with real-life relatability. She’s known for her trend-forward makeup looks, sharp product takes, and an eye for what’s actually worth your time — whether it’s a new launch, a holy-grail staple, or a viral moment that holds up off camera.
 Kayra Theodore
Celebrity Hair Artist Kayra Theodore is a celebrity hair artist and creative known for her sculptural braided styles and boundary-pushing approach to textured hair. Blending beauty, fashion, and artistry, Theodore has created viral looks for talents including Nara Smith while redefining hair as a form of creative expression.
 Jadé Marie
Content Creator & Holistic Esthetician Jadé Marie Chapman is a holistic esthetician, educator, and founder of JADÉ Complexions known for blending clinical skin care with wellness-focused rituals. Through her viral “Complexions by Jadé” content and decades-spanning beauty expertise, she’s become a trusted voice in skin care, self-care, and holistic beauty.
 Paloma Sanchez
Beauty Creator Paloma Sanchez is a beauty and lifestyle creator best known for her candid makeup tutorials, humorous beauty commentary, and highly relatable online presence. Through her viral TikTok content, Sanchez has built a devoted audience that turns to her for approachable glam inspo, product recommendations, and unfiltered takes on beauty trends.
